name: logbear MCP
description: Recognizes logbear's local stdio server, which reads captured dev-server output: read-only SQL over the log database, waiting for new entries, and diffing two runs against git history. Every tool keeps Guard's usual handling. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: logbear_query runs a single SELECT on a read-only connection: writes, ATTACH, PRAGMA and extension loading are refused, statements stop after 5 seconds, and results are capped at 2000 rows.
Captured output holds whatever a dev server prints, secrets included; keep credentials out of server logs, or run servers whose output an agent should not read without logbear.
logbear_diff runs only read-only git commands (rev-parse, log, diff, ls-files) to list commits and changed files between two recorded SHAs; it never checks out, fetches or writes to the repository.
logbear_ack only marks this session's errors as seen in logbear's own database; it never deletes log entries.
